description: This script processes Valgrind XML output files in a specified directory, summarizes error counts, and writes the results to a CSV file. It includes functions for parsing XML and handling file operations.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that creates the CSV report by processing Valgrind XML files in the output directory.

methods.name: ParseGtestXml
methods.description: Parses a Valgrind XML file to count different types of errors and determine if the test has failed.
